entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-09-14
entry.content:
Azure.Storage.Blobs.Batch_12.27.0-beta.2

12.27.0-beta.2 (2026-09-14)

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed bug where header values were not being sanitized for CR or LF characters when using BlobBatchClient APIs.

Azure.Storage.Blobs.Batch_12.26.1

12.26.1 (2026-09-14)

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed bug where header values were not being sanitized for CR or LF characters when using BlobBatchClient APIs.

Azure.ResourceManager.ContainerServiceFleet_1.3.0-beta.1

1.3.0-beta.1 (2026-09-11)

Features Added

  • Upgraded the service API version to 2026-06-02-preview.
  • Added Fleet managed namespace update support, including placement and propagation policies, rollout strategies, and cluster selectors.
  • Added scheduled start gates for update runs.
  • Added label-based member selection and configurable failure thresholds for update stages and groups.
  • Added the SecurityPatch auto-upgrade channel and additional trigger status details.

Azure.Provisioning.AppConfiguration_1.2.0-beta.2

1.2.0-beta.2 (2026-09-09)

Other Changes

  • Migrated code generation to TypeSpec.
